output_format_requirements: Return exactly the Boolean token True or False.
full_credit_requirements: Determine whether a consistent character mapping transforms the first string s into the second string t while preserving character order.
Every occurrence of the same character in s must map to the same character in t.
Distinct characters in s must not map to the same character in t.
A character is permitted to map to itself.
Return True exactly when such a mapping exists; otherwise return False.
not_specified: No partial-credit or reward policy is specified.

evidence.quote: Return True if the following two strings are isomorphic, or False otherwise:
All occurrences of a character must be replaced with another character while preserving the order of characters.
No two characters may map to the same character, but a character may map to itself.
